name: Sabbath The
overview: Scripture reveals the Sabbath as a divinely instituted day of rest, sanctified and blessed by God after His creation work was completed (Genesis 2:2-3). It is commanded to be kept holy, serving as a holy day for the Lord, where labor ceases and divine worship is celebrated (Exodus 20:8-9; Exodus 16:23). The provision of manna on the sixth day and its absence on the seventh underscores God's design for rest and reliance on His provision (Exodus 16:23, 27). Thus, the Sabbath embodies both a physical rest and a spiritual honor toward God in obedience to His command.
